requirements.reason: Community Game and Need a Sub content and chat moderation each require a distinct, category-aware open-case identity with a complete versioned current projection.
Assignment, internal note correction, manual closure, automatic closure, reopen, and merge must follow the frozen state machine without moving accepted child records or losing prior decisions.
Every material aggregate change must advance one gap-free version through finite attributed immutable events, with closure inputs retained as normalized immutable references.
Exact idempotency, expected-version checks, target-first locks, stable case locking, narrow retries, and atomic rollback must make concurrent case transitions converge without partial history.
Saved-content and chat source reconciliation plus accepted target-lifecycle closures must preserve historical findings and signals while selecting the exact case category and attribution.

The active-admin API and workspace must expose both moderation categories, assignment filters, versioned commands, linked history, and safe conflicts without exposing raw evidence or granting authority through assignment.
Models, canonical migrations, live PostgreSQL constraints and triggers, admin-action policy, and accepted moderation and authorization behavior must remain in parity.
